findings.title: GOV-017 never says where the Session Manager physically writes a verdict record before the builder has it.
findings.evidence: docs/08-governance/GOV-017-multi-session-coordination-protocol.md:192-199 ("The review" steps 3-4); tools/run_review_checks.py:220-236 removes the runner worktree in finally; PLAN-047 D4 says records are committed on the phase branch, not dev.
findings.consequence: An executing Session Manager following this text literally has nowhere to put the file: the runner worktree is gone, and writing into the primary checkout on dev needs a TURN? and would put an unmerged phase's record on dev.
findings.minimal_fix: Name the staging location explicitly (e.g. _working/session-manager/verdicts-pending/<verdict_id>.json), handed to the builder to copy into its own worktree at the stated path before committing.

findings.title: The merge-gate verdict-sha check names a checkout that has already been deleted, with no disambiguation.
findings.evidence: GOV-017.md:243-255, merge gate step 2: the runner's worktree is removed afterwards, then 'In a checkout of the branch tip, it runs sha256sum -c _working/session-manager/verdicts.sha256' without naming which checkout.
findings.consequence: The checkout is either already removed, the builder's own worktree (unstated), or a new SM worktree, which would reintroduce the separate detached-worktree step the phase's scope said to eliminate.
findings.minimal_fix: One sentence naming which checkout, ordered relative to the runner's worktree lifecycle.

findings.title: PROMPT-036's Validator template does not carry the coordinator brief the intro paragraph says it does, and the scope required both templates to.
findings.evidence: docs/02-prompts/PROMPT-036-build-coordinator.md:306-312 (intro: both templates 'briefed under GOV-017's brief rule') vs :325-328 (Validator 'Give it' list lacks the runner manifest path that :333 adds for the Adversary); GOV-017.md:188-189 lists demo-validator-code as a gating option with no PROMPT-036 dispatch instruction.
findings.condition: Change PROMPT-036 step 6 and its validator and adversary templates to name dedicated reviewer types and the coordinator brief, not the general-purpose charter.
findings.minimal_fix: Either drop Validator from the intro's brief-rule claim and say it is a step-4 pre-review check distinct from the GOV-017 build review, or add the manifest-path instruction to the Validator paragraph and show where PROMPT-036 dispatches it as the step-6 gating reviewer.

notes: Dispatched and briefed by the Session Manager by hand (phase-asr-04 acceptance: this phase's GOV-017 text is not yet on dev).
